title: BanglaBait: Semi-Supervised Adversarial Approach for Clickbait Detection on Bangla Clickbait Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection of clickbait using machine learning models and the creation of a new dataset. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as part of its core methodology or analysis. The topic of clickbait, while potentially having ethical implications, is approached from a technical classification standpoint in this paper.
